text: My daily routine is quite simple and well-organised. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a healthy breakfast and a quick shower. After that, I check my emails and plan my day. I work from nine to five, and I always take a short break at lunchtime to relax. In the afternoon, I go to the gym three times a week because exercise helps me stay healthy and focused. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a series, or read a book. I believe consistency is the key to a balanced and happy life.
